title: Room Temp — Weather App
description: A Flutter weather app pairing live forecasts, AQI and UV data with a physics-based thermal model that estimates indoor room temperature from outdoor conditions, sunlight exposure, and HVAC status.

title: First Aid Assistant
description: A robust, offline-first mobile application featuring local notifications for emergency data and native Jameel Noori Nastaleeq typography integration for localized user experiences.

title: Note App
description: A full-stack cross-platform notes application implementing clean MVVM architecture for strict separation of logic and UI, powered by a real-time cloud backend.
